title: Fleeces for the Wool Buyer
summary: Kestrel Crook wants 4 fleeces from the fair green taken to Poppy Sparrow before the fair opens on the green, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need fleeces, and what is stacked at the fair green is the town's to take. Carry it to Poppy Sparrow before the fair opens on the green, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Longmeadow that goes right."

objectives.text: Hand the fleeces to Poppy Sparrow
Tell Kestrel Crook it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
